summary: After every control step, replay the error-encoding pattern and pair it with stimulation of the motor pool that WOULD have moved each joint the right way (pro-pool 3 ms after the sensory volley: pre->post, potentiation under STDP) and of the opposite pool 3 ms before it (post->pre, depression). Sensory->motor STDP is the only plasticity the simulation models.
biological_basis: spike-timing-dependent plasticity in dissociated cortical cultures is induced by paired/tetanic electrical stimulation (e.g. Jimbo et al. 1999; Bi & Poo 1998 for the STDP window). Whether this exact 3 ms pairing potentiates the targeted pathway in a given culture is an empirical question -- measure it (see controls).

teacher.definition: dq* = J(q)^T (target - EE) / step_scale, J = EE position Jacobian of the controlled joints (Jacobian-transpose direction, in action units)
teacher.real_robot: computed from the robot's URDF and measured joint state; no culture involved

teach.sensory: error electrodes whose step level > volley index
teach.pro_pool: joint k: motor+ if dq*_k > 0 else motor-, for |dq*_k| >= select_frac * max|dq*|
teach.anti_pool: the other pool of each selected joint

feedback.note: not used by the simulated 'teach' rule. Optional DishBrain-style alternative if paired stimulation does not shape the culture: predictable stimulation after success, unpredictable (random electrodes/timing) after failure (Kagan et al. 2022). Electrodes: any unused, stimulation-responsive electrodes.

prerequisites: culture mature enough for network activity (typically >= 14-21 DIV for rodent cortical cultures; per your lab's protocol)
calibration_protocol.json completed in the same session
robot in a safe workspace (or use the simulated robot)

blocks.name: training
blocks.interleave: every 10 training episodes run 5 test episodes with teach off

session_plan.targets: held-out targets for tests, distinct from training targets

controls: sham: identical session with teach stimulation replaced by the same pulses at shuffled times (breaks the pre->post order)
decoder-only: decoder refit on stimulation patterns alone (no culture) -- the culture must beat it
no-culture / dead-culture well with identical electrodes
spontaneous drift: pre/post baseline recordings without stimulation
success_metrics: test-episode success rate and final error vs pre-test and sham
change in evoked sensory->motor responses (compare calibration probe maps before vs after; and with decoder.json sim_reference_io)
